title: Digital Auditory Cortex
text: DACx R/C++ package running biologically realistic simulations mammalian auditory cortex – “digital twin”. Network topologies built clusters cells, called nodes, arrayed three dimensions connected using circuit motifs. Network activity simulated using expanded version growth-transform (GT) membrane voltage time derivative introduced Gangopadhyay Chakrabartty. package built around several C++ object classes building networks: cell_type: struc specifying cell characteristics related membrane electrical properties kinetics, axon transmission speed, synaptic transmission, axon dendrite arborization. cell_arbors: struc efficiently storing manipulating large branching tree structures representing axonal dendritic arbors. motif: class specifying general patterns connectivity cells circuit, relative indexical pre-synaptic home column. network: class simulating spiking neural networks GT dynamical systems. Networks built using motifs, ultimately specify matrix transconductances (synaptic weights) cells. raison d’être networks compute signal transmission lag cells types arbors compute resulting network state GT membrane voltage time derivative \partial v/\partial t. “growth-transform” \partial v/\partial t? net metabolic power \mathcal{H} used spiking neural network can thought cost function network can thought mathematical manifold v membrane voltage values, one per cell. Gangopadhyay Chakrabartty shown apply Baum-Eagon inequality \mathcal{H} v derive function \partial v/\partial t=\sigma:v\rightarrow v guaranteed monotonically decrease \mathcal{H} time. function \sigma called growth transform. Although derivation \partial v/\partial t purely mathematical without reference biological phenomenon modeled, introductory tutorial spatial growth-transform models provides biologically interpreted motivated derivation. Example plot 3D network topology producable DACx.

title: Add new cell type — add.cell.type
text: function adds user-defined cell type current session. just wrapper Rcpp-exported add_cell_type function. Technically, cell_type struc defined Rcpp backend neurons package. essentially labeled lists following entries: type_name, valence, temporal_modulation_bias, temporal_modulation_timeconstant, temporal_modulation_amplitude, transmission_velocity, v_bound, dHdv_bound, I_spike, coupling_scaling_factor, spike_potential, resting_potential, threshold. session stores cell types Rcpp backend unordered_map string labels. parameters come biologically realistic (mathematically workable) default values, except type_name valence.

code: add.cell.type(   type_name,   valence,   temporal_modulation_bias = 0.001,   temporal_modulation_timeconstant = 1,   temporal_modulation_amplitude = 0.005,   transmission_velocity = 30000,   spine_density = 0,   axon_target = "dendrite_shaft",   v_bound = 85,   dHdv_bound = 1.05e-06,   I_spike = 1e-06,   spike_potential = 35,   resting_potential = -70,   threshold = -55,   axon_branch_count = 10,   dendrite_branch_count = 10,   branch_independence = 0.5,   branch_spread = 0.5,   apical_target_layer = "none" )

title: Add new cell type — add.cell.type
text: type_name Character string giving name cell type, e.g. "pyramidal", "PV", "SST", etc. valence Valence neuron type, +1 excitatory, -1 inhibitory temporal_modulation_bias Temporal modulation time (ms) bias neuron type. Default value 1e-3. temporal_modulation_timeconstant Temporal modulation time (ms) step neuron type. Default value 1e0. temporal_modulation_amplitude Temporal modulation time (ms) cutoff neuron type. Default value 5e-3. transmission_velocity Transmission velocity (microns/ms) neuron type. Default value 30e3. spine_density Scale 0 1; 0 = spines, 1 = every node along dendrite spine. Default 0.0. axon_target Character string giving target axon projections neuron type, one : "spine", "dendrite_shaft", "soma", "axon_shaft". Default "dendrite_shaft". v_bound Potential bound, -v_bound <= v_traces <= v_bound, unit_potential (mV), neuron network, based type. Default value 85.0. dHdv_bound Bound derivative metabolic energy wrt potential, dHdv_bound > abs(dHdv), mA, neuron network, based type. Default value 1.05e-6. I_spike Spike current, mA. Default value 1e-6 (.e., 1 nA). spike_potential Magnitude spike, mV. Default value 35.0. resting_potential Resting potential, mV. Default value -70.0. threshold Spike threshold, mV. Default value -55.0. axon_branch_count Expected number axon branches. Default 10. dendrite_branch_count Expected number dendrite branches. Default 10. branch_independence Scale 0 1; 0 = branches connect soma single segment, 1 = branches connect directly soma. Default 0.5. branch_spread Scale 0 1; 0 = tendency extend away soma, 1 = straight line away soma. Default 0.5. apical_target_layer Character string giving target layer apical dendrites. Default: "none".

title: Initialize neuron network — new.network
text: Mathematically, networks points (representing neurons) connected directed edges. Within growth-transform (GT) model framework, edges transconductance values representing synaptic connections neurons. Point types: Points can grouped types, affect behavior connectivity. Within GT model framework, types temporal modulation constants (determining, e.g., whether cell bursts fires singular spikes) valence (excitatory inhibitory). Global structure: Modelling mammalian cortex, networks assumed divide coarse-grained two-dimensional coordinate system layers (rows) columns (columns). point assigned layer-column coordinate (called "node"), local x-y coordinates within node global x-y coordinate within network. Local structure: layer-column coordinate defines "node" containing number points determined layer type. Connections (edges) within node determined local recurrence factor matrix determining transconductance points type. edges called "local". Long-range projections: Connections (edges) points different nodes determined long-range projection motif labelled motif.

Note plotting arbors can computationally intensive, advisable set low value (e.g., 0.01) unless plotting edges . arbor_cell_type Character string specifying cell type(s) include selecting cells arbor plotting; options include "" cell types, name (character vector names) specific cell type (default: ""). plot_motif Character string specifying motif plot (applies plotting edges; arbors can built multiple motifs, plot arbors motif); options include "" , "local connections" local connections within node, name long-range projection motif (default: ""). reconstruct_arbors Logical indicating whether reconstruct axonal dendritic arbors neurons plot, whether instead show synaptic connections straight edges (default: TRUE, can computationally intensive). edge_color Character string specifying color edges; options include "pre_type" color presynaptic neuron type, "post_type" color postsynaptic neuron type, "motif" color motif type, "is_axon" color whether reconstructed arbor axon dendrite (default: "pre_type"). use "post_type" "motif" reconstructing arbors, arbor edges can defined multiple postsynaptic neuron types motifs. use "is_axon" reconstructing arbors, edges defined axonal vs. dendritic processes. soma_color Character string specifying color nodes; options include "layer" color layer index "type" color neuron type (default: "layer"). soma_size_factor Numeric value controlling cell size plot scales number cells. return_plot Logical indicating whether return ggplot object print plot directly (default: TRUE). return_cell_arbor_idx Logical indicating whether return soma_mask arbor_idx used plotting (default: TRUE).
